verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer documents Autofix, which automatically scans incoming issues, finds root causes and automates triage, and can generate a code fix and open a PR. The marketing site also claims 'Automatically root-cause any issue', and Seer Agent answers questions by finding the relevant telemetry. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of root-cause accuracy, in-depth docs on how the investigation works, explicit evidence that Seer investigates alerts (not just issues).
